sn_aia_tool.description: Use this tool to create an official Fraud Case on sn_bom_fraud_case with Service Definition 'Report Fraud via Voice AI'. Automatically prefills account, contact, financial account (sold_product), disputed transaction, total fraud amount, and channel as 'voice_ai'. Returns 'case_sys_id' and 'case_number'.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"financial_account_sys_id","description":"The sys_id of the compromised financial account","mandatory":false},{"name":"contact_sys_id","description":"The sys_id of the customer contact","mandatory":false},{"name":"account_sys_id","description":"The sys_id of the company account","mandatory":false},{"name":"phone_number","description":"The customer phone number","mandatory":false},{"name":"disputed_transaction_sys_id","description":"The sys_id of the disputed transaction","mandatory":false},{"name":"transaction_sys_id","description":"Alternate parameter for transaction sys_id","mandatory":false},{"name":"disputed_amount","description":"Total amount disputed as fraudulent (e.g. 898.75)","mandatory":false},{"name":"disputed_merchant","description":"The merchant or description of the fraudulent charge","mandatory":false},{"name":"card_blocked","description":"Whether the card or account has been restricted / blocked","mandatory":false},{"name":"fraud_reason","description":"Reason for reporting fraud (e.g. Unauthorized transaction)","mandatory":false},{"name":"ai_notes","description":"Summary notes compiled by the Voice AI agent","mandatory":false}]
sn_aia_tool.name: create_fraud_case_via_voice_ai
